infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ReeferON needs camera access to capture temperature sensor photos for daily chamber logs.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ReeferON needs photo library access when you choose or save verification images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ReeferON may save captured temperature photos to your library when you export or share them.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: ReeferON sends permission-request alerts for Sub-Admins and task reminders for Data Operators.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ReeferON records GPS coordinates when you capture verification photos so supervisors can verify where photos were taken.
